description: This file declares the ServerControllerImpl class, which implements the IController interface for IPC server control in the Rialto project. It provides server-side methods for handling RPC failures, client retrieval, and cancellation, and is part of the IPC namespace.

classes.name: ServerControllerImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Rialto IPC server controller interface, managing RPC call failures, client info, and cancellation.

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure state and reason for the RPC call.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the RPC call has been canceled.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked if the RPC call is canceled.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the client that made the RPC request.
